title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省 Batac市镇 Batac 综合医院的名称变更为Marcos 纪念医院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Batac General Hospital in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Marcos Memorial Hospital
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Batac General Hospital in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Marcos Memorial Hospital
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Batac General Hospital tại Thị trấn Batac, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte thành Bệnh viện tưởng niệm Marcos
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Batac General Hospital ในเทศบาล Batac, จังหวัด Ilocos Norte เป็นโรงพยาบาลอนุสรณ์ Marcos
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Batac General Hospital di Kotamadya Batac, Provinsi Ilocos Norte menjadi Rumah Sakit Peringatan Marcos
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Batac General Hospital di Perbandaran Batac, Wilayah Ilocos Norte menjadi Hospital Peringatan Marcos

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6229_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Batac General Hospital in the Municipality of Batac, Province of IIocos Norte, is hereby changed to Marcos Memorial Hospital, thereby amending Republic Act Numbered Fifty-one hundred ninety-one.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
